name: [R1] Server-zone host contacting an external LLM API
message:
Outbound to an external LLM API from a server/production host. Autonomous AI-agent harnesses need continuous LLM inference; egress from a host with no approved LLM use is high-signal. Verify the host's business purpose; if not approved, contain (block egress) and inspect processes/containers.

Tune: define @network.client.zone and allowlist approved LLM hosts.

queries.name: llm_egress
queries.query: source:(proxy OR firewall OR dns) @network.destination.name:(api.openai.com OR api.anthropic.com OR api.openrouter.ai OR openrouter.ai OR api.deepseek.com) @network.client.zone:(server OR production OR dmz)
